title: Source validated citation and numerical controls
purpose: This document exercises software checks using two source-correct references and separate synthetic numerical examples. It is not a research manuscript or a representative accuracy sample.
literature_text: Kucsko et al. (2013) describe nanoscale thermometry in living cells. Yue and Wang (2012) review nanoscale thermal probing techniques.
statistics_scope: The numerical examples are synthetic software controls and do not describe either cited publication. The descriptive table and t-test are separate independent examples.
inferential_text: For the first independent synthetic example, a two-sided t-test gives t(28) = 2.45, p = .021.
descriptive_text: The separate second synthetic example measures one integer-valued item in ten independent responses. Each respondent contributes exactly one integer response. Seven responses are 3 and three responses are 4, giving an integer total of 33.
references: Kucsko, G., Maurer, P. C., Yao, N. Y., Kubo, M., Noh, H. J., Lo, P. K., Park, H., & Lukin, M. D. (2013). Nanometre-scale thermometry in a living cell. Nature, 500(7460), 54-58. https://doi.org/10.1038/nature12373
Yue, Y., & Wang, X. (2012). Nanoscale thermal probing. Nano Reviews, 3(1), 11586. https://doi.org/10.3402/nano.v3i0.11586

references.title: Nanometre-scale thermometry in a living cell

expected.scope: Require actual reference metadata agreement and applicable numerical computation. Claim-support uncertainty is recorded separately. No whole-F5, semantic, F4/F7, whole-UAT or representative accuracy claim.
